<includeonly><code style="display: inline">{{{1|{{{code|-No code provided-{{TemplateCase||[[Category:ic template usage error]]}}}}}}}}</code></includeonly><noinclude>{{Doc/Template
|descr= This template displays '''i'''nline '''c'''ode. It also adds the page to the [[:Category:ic template usage error|ic template usage error]] category on usage error.
|param1= code
|descr1= the code to display.<br>If it contains an equal sign {{hl|c= =}}:
** replace it with {{hl|c= <nowiki>{{=}}</nowiki>}}
** use {{hl|c= code=}} (see example 4)
** use the MediaWiki trick {{hl|c= 1=}} (see example 5)
|example1= <nowiki>{{ic}}</nowiki>
|result1= {{ic}}
|example2= <nowiki>{{ic|[[player]] [[setDamage]] 1;}}</nowiki>
|result2= {{ic|[[player]] [[setDamage]] 1;}}
|example3= <nowiki>{{ic|_fog {{=}} [[fog]];}}</nowiki>
|result3= {{ic|_fog {{=}} [[fog]];}}
|example4= <nowiki>{{ic|code= _fog = [[fog]];}}</nowiki>
|result4= {{ic|code= _fog = [[fog]];}}
|example5= <nowiki>{{ic|1= _fog = [[fog]];}}</nowiki>
|result5= {{ic|1= _fog = [[fog]];}}
|historical= y
}}</noinclude>
